statement.zh-TW: 海風民宿沒有任何流動負債，所以它的流動比率是所有公司裡最高的。
statement.en: Sea Breeze Guesthouse has no current liabilities at all, so its current ratio is the highest of any company.

feedbackTrue.zh-TW: 沒有短期債務確實是好事，這個直覺沒錯。但分母為零的比率沒有定義，根本算不出數字，也就沒辦法和其他公司比高低；正確的呈現是 N/A，再另外說明公司目前沒有流動負債。
feedbackTrue.en: Having no short-term debt is indeed good, so the instinct is sound. But a ratio with a zero denominator is undefined: there is no figure at all, so it cannot be ranked against other companies. The right presentation is N/A, with a separate note that the company currently has no current liabilities.

feedbackFalse.zh-TW: 答對了。分母為零時比率沒有定義，不是「很大」也不是「最高」；網站顯示 N/A（分母不存在），不顯示無限大，也不拿它和其他公司排名。
feedbackFalse.en: Correct. With a zero denominator the ratio is undefined, neither ‘very large’ nor ‘the highest’. The site shows N/A (no denominator) rather than infinity, and does not rank it against other companies.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_c8r1t4zm}}的分母是{{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}。沒有流動負債的公司短期內沒有還款壓力，但這件事要用文字說明，不是用一個「無限大」或「最高」的數字表示。課程有些說明把這種情況寫成趨近無限大；網站一律顯示 N/A（分母不存在），因為分母為 0 時比率沒有定義，N/A 也和「分母存在但結果為 0」不一樣。
explanation.en: The denominator of the {{term:tm_c8r1t4zm}} is {{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}. A company with no current liabilities has no short-term repayment pressure, but that is something to state in words, not with a figure called ‘infinity’ or ‘the highest’. Some course explanations describe this case as tending to infinity; the site always shows N/A (no denominator), because a ratio is undefined when its denominator is 0, and N/A is not the same as a result of zero from a denominator that exists.
